sources.officialityEvidence: The current Justice Ministry legal-text portal publishes the full Law No. 88-025, including its foreign-national scope, qualified visa requirement, visa categories, issuance authorities, special-document rules and admission controls.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sous réserve des conventions internationales dûment publiées ... tout étranger doit être muni ... d’un visa comorien.

policies.title: Comorian ordinary passport: citizenship
policies.summary: A traveller using a Comorian ordinary passport is classified as a Comorian citizen rather than as a foreign visitor under the foreigner-entry visa regime.
conditions: This is a narrow catalogue home-country classification: the foreigner-entry law applies to people of foreign nationality, while the Nationality Code determines Comorian nationality.
It does not establish treatment for a dual national presenting another passport, or for work, residence, transit, special passports, document validity, public-order controls or final admission.
